thread:
Maria (AE): Quick sync — EmberWave pilot kickoff. Need to lock which user journeys we run and the acceptance metrics. Who can own the tech checklist?

Sourabh (Solutions): I can take tech ownership. Quick clarifying Qs: which surfaces are must-have for the trial — real-time chat summarization, KB search/embeddings, or candidate re-ranking? Also, is SSO mandatory for test staging?

Ellie (PM): My suggested order: 1) live chat summarization (short digest + highlights), 2) semantic search over support KB (embeddings + recall), 3) optional answer reranking. Proposed 3-week timeline: week 1 ingest + integration, week 2 run evals + iter, week 3 joint demo + decision.

Taylor (Sales Eng): Draft success criteria to discuss: p95 latency <600ms for chat generate on staging, embedding recall@10 >= 0.70 on their labeled queries, human judged answer pass-rate >=85% on target prompts, and a cost guardrail (we'll propose number in pricing note). If they need SSO in pilot we can support SAML but it'll add ~3 days.

Sam (Security): EmberWave sent a checklist. Immediate asks: SAML SSO, audit logs, encrypted-at-rest, and an option for on-prem connector later. Hosted pilot OK only if data retention <=30d and no PHI in sample data. I'll fill and return their questionnaire by Wednesday EOD.

Sourabh (Solutions): Minimal endpoints for first pass: POST /v1/chat.generate (streaming ok), POST /v1/embeddings.create, POST /v1/rerank (opt). Ask EmberWave to provide: 5-10 sample convo threads (~10k tokens total) + 50 search queries with relevance labels (gold) so we can run recall/MRR.

Maria (AE): On commercials: offer a pilot credit covering Dedicated-equivalent capacity for 6 weeks + 10k embedding units free. Pilot has no SLA; we'll mention SLAs only on committed contracts. Taylor will confirm discount/credits and send a short note.

Taylor (Sales Eng): I'll put numbers in tomorrow. For immediate onboarding they can test with this curl to staging: 

```bash
curl -X POST "https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the convo below in 3 bullet points:"}],"stream":false}'
```

Sourabh (Solutions): I'll assemble a lightweight eval harness: metrics = ROUGE/BLEU for summarization, recall@10 + MRR for embeddings, and a binary human pass/fail for quality prompts. Need ~30-50 gold examples per task to be meaningful.

Ellie (PM): Suggested priority matrix: HIGH = chat summarization + search; MED = rerank, caching; LOW = fine-tune/few-shot tuning. Can we commit to delivering prompt templates + eval harness by Monday?

Maria (AE): Action items: Sourabh owns integration & deliverables (prompt templates + eval harness) — due Mon. Taylor owns pricing details & credits — due Mon. Sam completes security questionnaire — due Wed EOD. Ellie will sync acceptance criteria with EmberWave PM. I'll send the pilot one-pager tonight. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: staging cluster for emberwave-trial provisioned at https://staging.redwood.ai/emberwave-trial — credentials shared via secure DM.

Sourabh (Solutions): ACK. I'll start ingestion once Maria confirms they uploaded sample logs. Ping me for a pairing session if needed.
